description.en-US:
Unable to meet basic requirements:
Lack basic knowledge and skills required to perform responsibilities; often make mistakes and omissions; consistently fail to meet basic requirements.
description.zh-CN: 缺乏履行岗位职责所必须的知识和技能，在工作结果的交付效率和质量上达不到基本要求，与组织内其他人相比，工作产出明显偏低。

description.en-US:
Unable to consistently meet standard requirements:
Needs improvement in one or more essential areas; sometimes fails to meet standard requirements and occasionally causes complaints from internal or external clients.
description.zh-CN: 工作偶尔能达到岗位职责的基本要求，在工作结果的交付上与岗位期望存在一定差距，在工作的一个或多个方面存在明显需要改进的地方。

description.en-US:
Consistently meet requirements:
Consistently meet requirements in all essential areas without major deviations. Overall performance is stable and satisfying.
description.zh-CN: 勉强能够达到岗位职责的基本要求，在工作结果的交付效率和质量上大多数时候能达到岗位期望，但偶尔会有瑕疵，在工作结果交付的稳定性上有提升空间。

description.en-US:
Consistently meet requirements:
Consistently meet requirements in all essential areas without major deviations. Overall performance is stable and satisfying.
description.zh-CN: 能够达到岗位职责的基本要求，在工作结果的交付效率和质量上能够持续达到岗位期望，工作表现良好且稳定，是组织内主要的贡献者。

description.en-US:
Consistently meet requirements:
Consistently meet requirements in all essential areas without major deviations. Overall performance is stable and satisfying.
description.zh-CN: 能够达到岗位职责的基本要求且偶尔会超出预期，在工作结果的交付效率和质量上能够持续达到岗位期望，且偶尔超出预期，能为协作组织/人提供一定的支持。

description.en-US:
Often exceed requirements:
Often exceed requirements in terms of efficiency and quality with significant contributions. Overall quality of work is great and gain positive feedback from internal and external clients.
description.zh-CN: 能够经常有超出岗位预期的表现，在工作结果的交付效率和质量上超出期望，为协作组织/人提供有力的支持并得到认可。

description.en-US:
Make significant contributions to the company/industry:
Achieve a breakthrough on company-level issues or significantly contribute to the company's long-term financial or strategic benefits, even redefine industry standard through innovative practices.
description.zh-CN: 取得杰出的业绩，工作表现明显高于组织内其他员工，为协作组织/人提供极大的支持，是部门内所有员工的行为榜样。

description.en-US:
Unable to meet basic requirements:
Lack basic knowledge and skills required to perform responsibilities; often make mistakes and omissions; consistently fail to meet basic requirements.
description.zh-CN: 突破底线，缺乏基本的素质和自我要求。有明显违反创梦价值观要求的行为，造成重大后果或产生恶劣影响。

description.en-US:
Unable to consistently meet standard requirements:
Needs improvement in one or more essential areas; sometimes fails to meet standard requirements and occasionally causes complaints from internal or external clients.
description.zh-CN: 经常无法践行创梦价值观要求或言行不一致，偶尔表现出符合创梦价值观要求的行为或事迹，或虽然认可创梦价值观要求但未能经常表现，有较多负面评价。

description.en-US:
Consistently meet requirements:
Consistently meet requirements in all essential areas without major deviations. Overall performance is stable and satisfying.
description.zh-CN: 勉强符合创梦价值观要求，偶尔有言行或事迹不符合创梦价值观要求，或虽然整体认可创梦价值观要求但未能持续稳定表现，偶有负面评价。

description.en-US:
Consistently meet requirements:
Consistently meet requirements in all essential areas without major deviations. Overall performance is stable and satisfying.
description.zh-CN: 能够持续践行创梦价值观要求，在通常情况下，能持续稳定地表现出符合创梦价值观要求的行为或事迹，鲜有负面评价。

description.en-US:
Consistently meet requirements:
Consistently meet requirements in all essential areas without major deviations. Overall performance is stable and satisfying.
description.zh-CN: 持续稳定地践行创梦价值观，且有一些较为突出的符合创梦价值观要求的行为或事迹；对身边同事有较为积极的影响，收获了一些好评。

description.en-US:
Often exceed requirements:
Often exceed requirements in terms of efficiency and quality with significant contributions. Overall quality of work is great and gain positive feedback from internal and external clients.
description.zh-CN: 团队中的榜样，有较多突出的符合创梦价值观要求的行为或事迹，并且对团队有积极影响，起到示范和带动作用，有较多好评。

description.en-US:
Make significant contributions to the company/industry:
Achieve a breakthrough on company-level issues or significantly contribute to the company's long-term financial or strategic benefits, even redefine industry standard through innovative practices.
description.zh-CN: 公司中的楷模，即使在很复杂特殊的情况下也能表现出符合创梦价值观的行为或事迹，对团队有影响，和组织融为一体，有丰富的事例和广泛的好评。

description.en-US:
Unable to meet basic requirements:
Lack basic knowledge and skills required to perform responsibilities; often make mistakes and omissions; consistently fail to meet basic requirements.
description.zh-CN: 1.工作拖延，经常有工作积压2.在团队内制造、传递负能量，破坏团队合作氛围；3.工作中推诿、甩锅，存在畏难情绪；4.工作划水，经常在上班时间做与工作无关的事情。

description.en-US:
Unable to consistently meet standard requirements:
Needs improvement in one or more essential areas; sometimes fails to meet standard requirements and occasionally causes complaints from internal or external clients.
description.zh-CN: 1.对工作缺乏热爱和耐心，应付了事；2.部分工作流于表面，解决问题时头疼医头、脚疼医脚，缺乏思考；3.回避困难；4.不愿意承担更多工作责任，有时无法满足工作需求。

description.en-US:
Consistently meet requirements:
Consistently meet requirements in all essential areas without major deviations. Overall performance is stable and satisfying.
description.zh-CN: 1.工作仅满足上级的要求，但缺乏自己的深入的思考；2.不愿意承担挑战性目标；或愿意设定挑战性目标，但却疏于有效的监控和跟踪工作；3.偶尔不愿意承担更多工作责任。

description.en-US:
Consistently meet requirements:
Consistently meet requirements in all essential areas without major deviations. Overall performance is stable and satisfying.
description.zh-CN: 1.热爱本职工作，展现较高的兴趣；2.不制造、不传递负能量，不做影响团队合作的事；3.主动设定有挑战的目标，并持续跟进；4.使工作形成闭环，对工作负责到底，利用好OKR工具进行持续跟进；5.若有工作需要，不介意有额外付出。

description.en-US:
Consistently meet requirements:
Consistently meet requirements in all essential areas without major deviations. Overall performance is stable and satisfying.
description.zh-CN: 1.热爱本职工作，践行工作无小事，小事也用心做好；2.在职责边界不清晰的时候能够向前一步主动承担；3.主动设定有挑战的目标，迎难而上；4.愿意经常投入额外时间或资源，推动目标的达成。

description.en-US:
Often exceed requirements:
Often exceed requirements in terms of efficiency and quality with significant contributions. Overall quality of work is great and gain positive feedback from internal and external clients.
description.zh-CN: 1.热爱本职工作，即使小事也追求做到极致；2.能赋能团队，传递积极向上的正能量，推动团队目标达成；3.主动补位，能主动承担分外工作；4.对工作有深入思考，持续输出高质量OKR，不断地反思总结和复盘，形成有价值的经验。

description.en-US:
Make significant contributions to the company/industry:
Achieve a breakthrough on company-level issues or significantly contribute to the company's long-term financial or strategic benefits, even redefine industry standard through innovative practices.
description.zh-CN: 1.不计较个人得失，始终把满足工作要求放在第一位；2.对于分外工作（包括但不限于通道建设、交流分享、培训等）也取得了突出的贡献；3.任何情况下都能自我驱动，不断对自己的工作目标提出新的、更高的要求，持续突破舒适区并取得业绩提升；4.解决合作中的障碍，调停合作中的矛盾，能够提出具有建设性可落地的意见，为问题获得最优解，高效推进目标达成。

description.en-US:
Unable to meet basic requirements:
Lack basic knowledge and skills required to perform responsibilities; often make mistakes and omissions; consistently fail to meet basic requirements.
description.zh-CN: 工作消极，有明显的倦怠：无法投入到工作中，对工作的兴趣较低或持续情绪低落，创造力枯竭，缺少对工作的思考，体验不到工作的价值，无法承担工作责任。

description.en-US:
Unable to consistently meet standard requirements:
Needs improvement in one or more essential areas; sometimes fails to meet standard requirements and occasionally causes complaints from internal or external clients.
description.zh-CN: 有时表现消极：工作中不能始终保持积极投入，偶尔出现消极和倦怠，在个别事情上没有投入足够多的精力和心思，欠缺深度思考，不愿意承担更多工作责任，有时无法满足工作需求。

description.en-US:
Consistently meet requirements:
Consistently meet requirements in all essential areas without major deviations. Overall performance is stable and satisfying.
description.zh-CN: 能够基本应对工作：对工作付出较多投入，但并未展现较高兴趣。在涉及到的工作中虽然能投入一些精力和心思，但思考还不够深入。偶尔不愿意承担更多工作责任。

description.en-US:
Consistently meet requirements:
Consistently meet requirements in all essential areas without major deviations. Overall performance is stable and satisfying.
description.zh-CN: 能够持续积极应对工作：对工作付出较多投入，展现较高的兴趣，基本上能做到在所有涉及的工作中都能投入较多的精力和心思，有较多深度思考，乐于承担更多责任，不介意有额外付出。

description.en-US:
Consistently meet requirements:
Consistently meet requirements in all essential areas without major deviations. Overall performance is stable and satisfying.
description.zh-CN: 能够持续积极应对工作，展现了比较高的工作动机：对工作付出了很多精力，展现了很高的兴趣，对所有涉及到的工作都能投入很多的精力和心思。有很多深度思考，较为积极地承担更多责任，不介意有额外付出。

description.en-US:
Often exceed requirements:
Often exceed requirements in terms of efficiency and quality with significant contributions. Overall quality of work is great and gain positive feedback from internal and external clients.
description.zh-CN: 展现非常高的工作动机和工作投入：工作中投入非常多的精力，对工作非常有兴趣，有很高的工作热情，压力状态下也展现出非常好的适应水平，展现出非常好的自驱力，有很多深度思考，积极主动承担更多工作责任和风险，基本上能做到始终把满足工作要求放在第一位。

description.en-US:
Make significant contributions to the company/industry:
Achieve a breakthrough on company-level issues or significantly contribute to the company's long-term financial or strategic benefits, even redefine industry standard through innovative practices.
description.zh-CN: 工作动机和工作投入极高：工作上能始终保持高水平投入，展现了极高的兴趣和热情，任何情况下都能体现出极高的自我驱动，将自我与工作融为一体，对工作的思考非常全面并有深度。任何情况下都始终把满足工作要求放在第一位，非常敬业并有奉献精神。
